info.title: openconfig-openflow
info.description:
OpenConfig OpenFlow configuration and operational state data.

This module defines configuration and operational state data for OpenFlow, including controller connections and agent settings. It augments the OpenConfig system model (`/openconfig-system:system`) with an `openflow` container.

**Module:** `openconfig-openflow`
**Namespace:** `http://openconfig.net/yang/openflow`
**Augments:** `/openconfig-system:system`
**Version:** 0.1.1
**Paths:** 17

get.description:
Retrieve the full OpenFlow configuration including controllers and agent settings.

**CLI equivalent:** `show openflow`

put.description:
Create or replace the full OpenFlow configuration.

**CLI equivalent:** `openflow` configuration mode

get.description: Retrieve OpenFlow controller configuration and connection state.

put.description: Create or replace the OpenFlow controllers list.

get.description: Retrieve a specific OpenFlow controller configuration by name.

put.summary: Create or replace a specific OpenFlow controller

get.description: Retrieve OpenFlow agent configuration including datapath-id, failure mode, and timing parameters.

put.summary: Create or replace OpenFlow agent configuration
put.description:
Create or replace the OpenFlow agent settings.

**Key parameters:**
- `datapath-id`: Unique identifier for the OpenFlow datapath
- `failure-mode`: Behavior when controller connection is lost (SECURE or STANDALONE)
- `backoff-interval`: Initial interval between controller connection attempts
- `max-backoff`: Maximum interval between connection attempts
- `inactivity-probe`: Interval before probing idle controller connections

get.description: Retrieve a specific OpenFlow connection by controller name and auxiliary ID.

parameters.name: aux-id
parameters.description: Auxiliary connection ID (0 for main connection)

put.summary: Create or replace a specific OpenFlow connection

openconfig-openflow-openflow.description: Top-level OpenFlow container with controllers and agent

backoff-interval.description: Initial interval between controller connection attempts (seconds)

max-backoff.description: Maximum interval between controller connection attempts (seconds)

inactivity-probe.description: Interval before probing an idle controller connection (seconds)
